$comment: SCR-assurance's data (docs/DESIGN.md SCR-assurance; spine section 8.9; OD-8). Each course claim carries the raw output its stamp is derived from (packages/stamps deriveStamp, never typed), the runs that hold its numbers, the gates that back it and the README section it answers. A red night in status/nightly.json naming one of those gates marks the claim 'unverified since <date>'. Numbers here are copied from the named runs' values and verdict lines.

claims.limit: One fixture family so far; the course's own generator families join as they ship.

raw.unit: instances, the same in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit and on the host

claims.limit: Three solutions on the S2 ledger pack; each challenge pack adds its own.

claims.limit: One bypass; other bypasses need their own replay.

claims.limit: The S3 fragment and the S9 target IR. The S7 access extension has no Lean reference.

raw.why: held: lake comparator --paranoid runs 6 checkers at every Lean Defence

claims.limit: 13 of 69 specimens reproduced; 20 are recorded only and 36 wait for their runs.

No blind strategy beats chance at the Audit Desk by more than 2 SD

No private-design term, personal identifier, email or private path is published

claims.text: The course raises what a learner can do

raw.what: no outcome data beyond one learner, and no causal claim

claims.limit: Expected effects are tenths of a standard deviation at most; the median education effect is about 0.10 SD (Kraft, 2020).

claims.text: Provenance on receipts and answers is what the learner declared

raw.why: the honor system: provenance is self-declared and calibrates rather than polices (OD-8)

claims.limit: A determined learner can declare anything; the course says so.

erosionLog.text: On the two inputs of Z3 issue #11179, both satisfiable, 5.3.0 answers unsat and 5.3.1 answers unknown. The course's assumption that the solver is sound cracks for 5.3.0, so every solver PROVED keeps the "uncertified" qualifier and the pin stays 5.3.1.
The full reachable space of the unsafe double-spend spec, re-run on the 1.8.0 jar: the same 11, 45, 191 and 813 distinct states. No diff.
The same specimens on both releases: 53 of 53 steps, 200 of 200 worlds and 10 of 10 single-session steps equal. No diff.
Goal Replay's strips regenerated on the release candidate: 0 of 9 strips differ. No diff.
A simulated toolchain bump changes 3 of 9 Goal Replay strips and 8 of 33 states. A reviewed diff like this one becomes an EROSION entry on this log.

pins.detail: on the Bench, with real concurrent sessions

cannot: Oracles are visible to a determined learner: a static site cannot hide them.
Defence Part B has no outcome data.
The course's measurements describe one learner (n = 1) and support no causal claim.
honor: Provenance runs on the honor system (OD-8). Every answer, receipt and claim carries what you declared: your own work, assisted, or an agent's. The course weighs it at read time and never checks it. Nothing can, from a static site, and the course does not pretend otherwise.
expect: Expect effects of a few tenths of a standard deviation at most. The median effect in education trials is about 0.10 SD (Kraft, 2020), and nothing here adds up to more.
